prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1157; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at a signalized intersection in Katy, Texas. I was turning left across the lanes to get into a shopping center driveway.

Q: What were the weather and lighting conditions?

A: It was clear and still daylight. The pavement was dry.

Q: Walk me through what happened when you started the turn.

A: I waited for the light to change and saw the oncoming traffic had a green. I thought I had a gap, so I started to go. Then a car came through much faster than I expected and hit the front passenger side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your turn?

A: Not clearly. I looked, but I didn't see it until it was almost on me.

Q: Did you feel any pain at the scene?

A: Not right away. My neck felt stiff, and within an hour my lower back was really sore. Since then I've had headaches and I can't turn my head fully to the right.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day. They diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy. I'm still going to therapy twice a week.

Q: Do you have any prior injuries to your neck or back?

A: I had some minor back soreness a few years ago from lifting, but nothing that required treatment, and it resolved on its own.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been missing work because of the pain, and I'd like the claim handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
